name: inertia-react-development
title_zh: Inertia v2 的 React 页面
tagline_zh: 写 Inertia 的 React 端总在猜 Link、Form、useForm 该用哪个。
tagline_en: Stop guessing whether to reach for Link, Form, useForm, or router in Inertia v2. It hands you the v2 way for.
desc_en: Develops Inertia.js v2 React client-side applications. Activates when creating React pages, forms, or navigation; using <Link>, <Form>, useForm, or router; working with deferred props, prefetching, or polling; or when user mentions React with Inertia, React pages, React forms, or React navigation.
why_zh: 把 Inertia v2 的 React 侧约定收成一套：该用组件还是 hook。
why_en: Codifies Inertia v2's React-side conventions: component vs. hook, when deferred props and prefetch belong, with a clear landing.
limit_zh: 只管 Inertia 的 React 客户端这一侧：服务端适配器、Vue/Svelte 版本。
limit_en: React client side of Inertia only: no server adapters, no Vue/Svelte, no v1 patterns. Without @inertiajs/react v2 installed, the API names won't.
title_en: Inertia v2 React pages, forms, and navigation
